title: N-Queens II

monster.name: Mortis the Grandmaster
monster.title: Arch-Lich of Combinatorial Checkmates
monster.defeatQuote: The total solution tally dispelled my curse...

description:
The n-queens puzzle is the problem of placing `n` queens on an `n x n` chessboard such that no two queens attack each other.

Given an integer `n`, return the number of distinct solutions to the n-queens puzzle.
hints: Count valid full placements at row === n instead of building string boards.

python.solutionCode:
def totalNQueens(n):
    count = 0
    cols, diag1, diag2 = set(), set(), set()
    def backtrack(r):
        nonlocal count
        if r == n:
            count += 1
            return
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or (r - c) in diag1 or (r + c) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.add(c)
            diag1.add(r - c)
            diag2.add(r + c)
            backtrack(r + 1)
            cols.remove(c)
            diag1.remove(r - c)
            diag2.remove(r + c)
    backtrack(0)
    return count
